answer: A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in jade, and kernel reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 89 aliases, and each one needs its own funded basalt account. A farm of 929 identities would post 634 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
